name: l4_failure_demo
description: Smallest L4 contrast: does surfacing a TRUSTED Failure artifact (plus its corrective Decision) stop an agent repeating a known dead end? Corpus also carries an LLM CANDIDATE (must stay a hypothesis), a superseded Decision (must read historical), and an evidence-less human note (un-promotable) so the brief's epistemic bucketing is exercised, not just the happy path. Anchored on the real cosine-floor recall regression in scoring_service.py.

artifacts.summary: fixed 0.15 cosine MIN_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD dropped BM25/facet candidates before ranking
artifacts.body: A hard cosine floor on similarity silently discarded low-cosine but high-value candidates (BM25 and facet hits), tanking recall. Floor must not gate before the ranker sees them.

artifacts.summary: rank all candidates and apply a source-aware floor after ranking, not before
artifacts.body: Replace the pre-rank hard floor with a source-aware threshold applied post-ranking so BM25/facet candidates survive to the ranker.

artifacts.summary: the floor may also interact badly with the recency boost on cosine scores
artifacts.body: LLM-proposed hypothesis: recency boost could push stale items over the floor. Unverified.

artifacts.summary: use a fixed 0.15 cosine floor on similarity to cut low-relevance candidates
artifacts.body: Original decision, superseded after it was shown to drop recall.

artifacts.summary: consider lowering the floor to 0.05 instead of removing it
artifacts.body: Human note with no evidence anchor — captured for review, must stay CANDIDATE and be un-promotable.

artifacts.summary: force_acquire overwrote an active scheduler lease, double-running a job
artifacts.body: Unrelated INCIDENT for type coverage; different anchor, should not surface for the floor task.

tasks.text: Recall is dropping low-cosine candidates — tighten the similarity floor in scoring.
